fields.features_heading: What a Rep Needs to Know Before the Call
fields.features_subheading: A template on paper waits for someone to read it. Emergent builds a questionnaire whose answers reach a rep before the call.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that change with the deal

Ask first what the prospect wants to buy. A software buyer then answers questions about team size and current tools, and a services buyer about project scope and launch date.
fields.feature_2:
Large prospects reach a senior rep

Set the line that makes a deal large, such as 50 staff or a $20,000 budget. Anyone above it goes to an account executive in Slack, and everyone else reaches the team by email.
fields.feature_3:
Answers written to the deal in your CRM

Connect HubSpot or any CRM with an API. Each finished questionnaire writes its answers onto the matching deal, where the rep also keeps the call notes and the next step.
fields.feature_4:
One question per screen on a phone

Prospects open the link from an email on their phone. The questionnaire shows one question at a time, with a large button for each answer and a progress bar along the top.
fields.feature_5:
Every answer kept in a database you own

Responses land in a database table you own, with no cap on how many prospects can answer each month. Filter by deal size, industry or timeline when you plan the quarter.
fields.feature_6:
The questionnaire's code, in your repository

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and host it next to the sales tools you already run. Anyone on the team can keep building on it from there.

fields.tab_content_1:
With 140 caregivers, this demo goes to Feodora

Orvanta sells shift scheduling software, and every demo request starts with its sales questionnaire. Pelloway Home Care reports 140 caregivers, scheduled in spreadsheets, and a March go-live. Prospects with 50 or more staff go to Feodora Halcott, an account executive, in Slack. She sends demo times the same day.
fields.tab_content_2:
Every redesign adds six questions about the live site

Saltreed Studio builds restaurant websites. Its questionnaire asks first: new site or redesign? Ondale Noodle Bar picks redesign, which opens six questions about the live site, such as what breaks on phones. New-site prospects never see them. The founder reads the prospect record before the discovery call.
fields.tab_content_3:
Roof from 2021, move by June 30: Pradeep knows

Mirovale Realty sends its seller questionnaire before every listing appointment. The owners of a 3-bedroom house on Neddick Lane report a roof replaced in 2021 and a June 30 move date. Their agent, Pradeep Lumsley, gets the answers by email the evening before. He brings sales of nearby homes with newer roofs.
fields.tab_content_4:
Price, which 9 of 23 lost buyers named, leads the chart

Caddenby sells inventory software. When a deal is marked lost in HubSpot, the buyer gets a 4-question questionnaire about the decision. Last quarter 23 buyers replied: price came up 9 times, missing integrations 6, timing 5, and other reasons 3. Each reply is saved to its deal in HubSpot, and the chart counts the reasons.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Sales Questionnaire Template
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to a sales questionnaire template that qualifies each prospect and puts the answers in front of the right rep.
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Branch the questions by deal type
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Keep each path short enough to finish
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down the facts a rep needs before agreeing to a call: company size, the problem, who signs, and when they want to start. BANT, short for budget, authority, need, and timeline, is a common checklist to start from.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Open with one question about what the prospect is buying, such as a product demo or a services project. Each answer leads to its own follow-ups. A redesign prospect then never wades through questions written for a software buyer.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Aim for eight to ten questions per path, which a prospect can finish on a phone in a few minutes. Use multiple choice for size and timeline, and save free text for the problem the prospect wants solved.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Choose the one answer that marks a prospect as large, and name the rep who takes those. Everyone else can share a team inbox. Settle the rule before building, because it decides who calls each prospect first.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Match responses to deals in the CRM
fields.howto_step_5_des: Connect the CRM where deals already live through its API, and match each response to a deal by the prospect's work email. Reps then read the answers next to their call notes instead of opening a separate tool.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Write one prompt that names the paths, the questions, the large-deal rule, and the CRM. Emergent builds the questionnaire, its database, and the alerts from it. Change any question later by prompting again in plain English.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Fill it in as a fake prospect
fields.howto_step_7_des: Before the link goes to real prospects, answer once as a large buyer and once as a small one. Check that each path asks its own questions, the Slack alert reaches the right rep, and the deal updates in the CRM.
fields.hero_prompt: Build a sales questionnaire template for my software company that asks prospects their team size and timeline before a demo.

faq_plan.q: What is a sales questionnaire template?
faq_plan.a: A sales questionnaire template is a reusable set of questions a sales team sends prospects before a call or a quote. It collects the facts that decide fit: the problem, the size of the team or project, who approves the purchase, and the start date. Reps read the answers first and spend the call on the deal.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a sales questionnaire template?
faq_plan.a: Decide what makes a prospect qualified, then write one path of questions per deal type. Describe the paths, the rule for large deals, and where answers should go to Emergent's AI form builder, and it builds the questionnaire with its database and alerts. Test it as a fake prospect before sharing the link.

faq_plan.q: What questions belong in a sales questionnaire template?
faq_plan.a: Start with the questions that decide fit, then add ones for what you sell. A software seller asks which tool the prospect uses today and how many seats it needs. A services firm asks for scope and a launch date. Keep one open question for the problem in the prospect's own words, which a rep can quote back on the call.

faq_plan.q: Can a sales questionnaire template ask different prospects different questions?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Put a deal-type question first and give each answer its own follow-ups. A prospect sees only the questions on their own path. The same branching suits lighter forms: a boo basket questionnaire can skip the allergy questions for a family that reports none.

faq_plan.q: When in the sales process should a sales questionnaire template be used?
faq_plan.a: Use it right after the prospect asks for a demo or a quote, and before anyone books a call. The answers then shape the call agenda. For inbound leads, put the questionnaire on the demo request page itself, and the prospect fills it in as part of the request.

faq_plan.q: How do I route answers from a sales questionnaire template to the right rep?
faq_plan.a: Write a routing rule on one or two answers, such as team size or start date, and name the rep on each side of the line. Combine answers when one is not enough: a large team that plans to start in two years may not need a senior rep yet. Emergent builds the Slack and email alerts for each route from the prompt.

faq_plan.q: Is a sales questionnaire template the same as a new client questionnaire?
faq_plan.a: No. A sales questionnaire comes before the deal and decides whether a prospect fits and who should call them. A new client questionnaire comes after the contract and collects what the work needs. An agency's SEO client questionnaire, for instance, asks for site access and goals once the client has signed.

faq_plan.q: How long should a sales questionnaire template be?
faq_plan.a: Short enough that a prospect finishes it in a few minutes on a phone. Say at the top how long it takes, and show a progress bar as they go. Put quick multiple-choice questions first and contact details near the end. Leave out anything you can look up yourself, such as the company's website.

faq_plan.q: Can I reuse one sales questionnaire template for several products?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Keep the shared questions, such as company size and timeline, in one place and add a path for each product line. A new product then needs only its own follow-ups. Emergent keeps every response in one database you own, whichever path it took, and a dashboard can compare the paths side by side.

faq_plan.q: Should a sales questionnaire template ask about a buyer's values?
faq_plan.a: No. Keep it to what decides fit: need, size, authority, and timing. Questions about values, interests, and lifestyle belong in a psychographic questionnaire, which marketing teams use to understand an audience rather than to qualify one prospect. A rep can still ask about motivation on the call.
